_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Wɔreko Golf (Akwaduro Kɛseɛ) - Akwaduro kɛseɛfoɔ {player_id}.
Botaeɛ: Nyaa akontabuo ketewa wɔ round yi mu. Sɛ column biara wɔ kyerɛwdeɛ koro no ara a, wɔbɛtumi akɔntabuo no sɛ 0.
Akwaduro Kɛseɛ Nhoma: A=1, 2-10=kyerɛwdeɛ ketewa, J/Q=10, K=0

Adwuma (fa bracketed adwuma no pɛpɛɛpɛ):
- '[draw]' - Draw fii deck
- '[take]' - Fa fii discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Swap drawn akwaduro kɛseɛ nhoma no ne position X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Discard drawn akwaduro kɛseɛ nhoma no

board.drew:
Wɔyii: {card}
Afei wɔbɛtumi [swap X Y] anaa [discard] no.
board.took:
Wɔfaa: {card} fii discard pile
Wɔbɛtumi [swap X Y] no (mfa no nnyɛ discard).

options.final_turns: Awieeɛ turns! Wo nkyerɛwdeɛ: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.draw: Wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ ma wo: [draw], [take]
options.must_swap: Ɛsɛ sɛ: [swap X Y] (ntumi ntwe kaade mfi nneɛma a wɔtow gu mu)
options.swap_or_discard: Wopɛ sɛ wo: [swap X Y] anaa [discard]

hand.header: Kɔla: 1 2 3 kɔla a wɔaka ho asɛm no

action_desc.swapped: Akwaduro kɛseɛfoɔ {pid} swapped {new} ne {old} wɔ position ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Deck no awieeɛ! Awieeɛ no fii aseɛ.
message.knocked: Ɔbɔadeɛ {pid} no! Odiadefoɔ biara nya baako bio.
message.final_round: Akwaduro kɛseɛfoɔ {pid} {reason}! Akwaduro kɛseɛfoɔ biara bɛnya turn baako.

invalid.wrong_action: Fa action a ɛwɔ bracket nyinaa: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], anaa [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Nkyene a wɔtow gu no so nni hwee!
invalid.must_draw_first: Wopɛ sɛ wo di kan [draw], [take], [knock], anaa [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Wuntumi nyi kaade a wɔayi afi nea wɔde ato hɔ no mu. Ɛsɛ sɛ wosesa bi.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Woduu card. Wopɛ sɛ wo [swap X Y] anaa [discard] no.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Wohia nkrataa a wɔayi no bi de asesa.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Wohia krataa a wɔatwa ato hɔ bi na woatumi atu ase.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Adansedi no abɔ ho ban. Fa row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
